The fine_grained_classifier predicted 'tennis ball' likely due to color/texture dominance, but structurally it is incorrect. 3/6 testable checkpoints passed (Texture, Color, Hue), but the two most defining geometric features (Size, Seams) failed.

The background shows mild textural smearing. These issues compound to create a visibly AI-generated image with poor anatomical and physical coherence.
